summary: An immediate change. Flipping it does the thing — nothing is waiting on a Save button.

pairs.dont: Use a Switch for a value that a Save button confirms.
pairs.do: Use Switch for an immediate change, Checkbox for a form value.
pairs.why: A switch says the change has already happened. Putting one in a form makes people flip it, press Save, and wonder which of the two actually did the work.

pairs.dont: Pair a panel of switches with Save and Cancel.
pairs.do: Apply each change as it is made, and say so if it takes a moment.
pairs.why: Cancel cannot undo something that already took effect. If the change genuinely needs confirming, the control was never a switch.

pairs.dont: Use two switches for two mutually exclusive options.
pairs.do: Use a radio group — one tab stop, arrows to move, one answer.
pairs.why: Two switches can both be on. If that state is impossible, the control is lying about the shape of the question.

pairs.dont: Label a switch "Notifications off" and flip the meaning with its state.
pairs.do: Label the thing being switched — "Notifications" — and let on mean on.
pairs.why: A switch already carries the state. A negative label makes the on position mean off, which nobody reads correctly at a glance.

pairs.dont: Flip the switch optimistically and let it snap back when the request fails.
pairs.do: Hold the new position, show that it is saving, and explain it if it fails.
pairs.why: A control that moves by itself reads as a bug, and people stop trusting what the position tells them.

pairs.dont: Leave a disabled ON switch at full colour.
pairs.do: Mute it, so it reads as a setting nobody can currently change.
pairs.why: A live-looking switch invites a flip that does nothing, and no feedback follows to explain why.

a11y: Radix supplies role="switch" and aria-checked. A switch is on or off now, not a value to be submitted — use Checkbox when it is the latter.
Invalid is a ring, not a border: aria-invalid:shadow-ring-focus-danger. A mark has no border to recolour, which is the rule for every control of this shape.
The track border goes transparent when the switch is on, and the focus ring is a separate layer that is unaffected. Border is decoration, ring is the indicator — keep them independent.
